title: arctostaphylos uva-ursi subsp. sensitiva
intro: Arctostaphylos uva-ursi subsp. sensitiva, commonly known as sensitive bearberry, is a subspecies of the bearberry plant, characterized by its ability to thrive in acidic soils and its unique, pinkish-white flowers. The health benefits of Arctostaphylos uva-ursi subsp. sensitiva include its potential to treat urinary tract infections, due to its antibacterial properties, and its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with certain gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its astringent, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Arctostaphylos uva-ursi subsp. sensitiva include arbutin, a compound responsible for its astringent properties, as well as other flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its medicinal effects.
